notes: Han Shu 94 identifies its Xue Kuang as the son of Chancellor Xue Xuan, active from Emperor Ai's accession until his execution in Yuanshi 3 (AD 3). Han Shu 104 lists a Xue Kuang of Yangdi among regional strongmen who arose after Emperor Jing's suppression, before the account of Guo Xie. They are distinct men separated by well over a century.
